subject: Re: Monitor arm purchase
text: Hi there, Following up on my earlier message about the monitor arm I was eyeing for the lab desk, I did some more comparing and I’m honestly leaning toward a different option. The original one still looks nice, but the price jumped after I checked out the weekend before last, and the shipping estimate became almost two weeks. Since I need something that won’t make my cramped desk worse, I found a low-profile version from the same brand that has a shallower clamp and a cable channel, which would actually suit our setup better. It also folds flat enough that I can tuck it under the shelf if the workshop uses the table for group work. I attached a screenshot of the measurements, and I noticed the screw hole spacing differs by about half an inch, so maybe you could check whether that causes any wobble. If you get a second, could you tell me whether this alternate seems practical? I’m also thinking of ordering a small mouse pad to cover the spot where the old arm was bolted, unless that looks too patchy. The student account still has the discount code, but I’m not sure whether it applies to clearance items. Anyway, I’d rather not guess and regret the purchase later, so I wanted to bounce the idea past you first. Thanks for always keeping me from buying shiny things that turn out to be terrible.
